rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act of choosing or the choice someone makes.

example.english: I still haven't made the final selection.
example.traditional: 我仲未作出最後嘅選擇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 mei6 zok3 ceot1 zeoi3 hau6 ge3 syun2 zaak6

rows.note: Use this for an assortment or range of several varieties of items, especially when naming the items after 幾款.

example.english: This place has a selection of cakes for you to choose from.
example.traditional: 呢度有幾款蛋糕畀你揀。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 jau5 gei2 fun2 daan6 gou1 bei2 nei5 gaan2

rows.note: Use this noun phrase for the particular item chosen, such as the thing someone finally picked.

example.english: My selection—the shirt I chose—is already out of stock.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaan2 ge3 saam1 ji5 ging1 mou5 fo3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a selected song or track being played, rather than for a general choice or assortment.

example.jyutping: bo3 ngo5 gaan2 go2 sau2 go1 laa1
